title: 6 Ways a Godly Man Carries Blame Before He Takes Credit
caption:
6 ways a godly man carries blame before he takes credit. Most men have that order backward.

He owns the mistake before he owns his side of the story. He takes the write-up to his boss with his name on it, not the team's. He confesses the failure before anyone comes looking for who caused it. He lets the younger guy's win stay the younger guy's, even the parts he built himself.

Christ took the blame that was never His to take, so the credit could go to men who never earned it. Not to us, Lord, but to your name be the glory.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
